decisive_basis.modern_v2_4_pilot_scope: only that a new v2.4.0 callset is reproducible/extraction-safe; a modern GO must NOT be substituted for the historical attribution
decisive_basis.independent_reverification: independent-prophage-rerun-verification-v1 re-derived 56/56 exact v2.3-vs-CSV reproduction, the v2.3-v2.4 +1 boundary signature, and inclusive saved-FASTA lengths without trusting the predecessor's comparison code

normalization.rule: retain exact source bytes, physical record number, every raw field string, parsed integer sensitivity values, and policy version; no row is removed or rewritten

scopes.rule: Decimal(raw transposable) == Decimal(1); observed raw member value is exactly 1.0
trimmed case-folded raw taxonomy is neither empty nor Unknown

semantic_dimensions.name: producer_and_caller_version
semantic_dimensions.value: Phigaro 2.3.0 native TSV (pinned commit aea9469, PyPI sdist 758012c...); all 56 cohort rows reproduced exactly

semantic_dimensions.name: tagged
semantic_dimensions.value: explicit unresolved user/source term; the CSV has no 'tagged' field and no subset is silently relabeled; the closest distinct scope is transposable_flag_positive, which is NOT aliased to 'tagged'

semantic_dimensions.name: transposable
semantic_dimensions.value: Phigaro 2.3.0 if_transposable() binary flag (Integration-group pVOG pattern); raw 1.0/0.0 reproduced exactly for all 56 cohort rows

semantic_dimensions.name: taxonomy_labels
semantic_dimensions.value: Phigaro 2.3.0 define_taxonomy() modal pVOG taxonomy codes (Unknown when none map); reproduced exactly for all 56 cohort rows

semantic_dimensions.name: coordinate_base_and_end_inclusivity
semantic_dimensions.value: 1-based inclusive boundary-gene coordinates; begin=genes[phage.begin].begin, end=genes[phage.end].end written verbatim by Phigaro 2.3.0 run_phigaro.py (commit aea9469); 56/56 cohort rows reproduced with begin_delta=0/end_delta=0; saved-FASTA length=end-begin+1 for all 56 (inclusive); v2.4.0 writes begin-1/end-1 (off-by-one) confirming the version signature

semantic_dimensions.name: strand_orientation
semantic_dimensions.value: absent from the source by design; Phigaro 2.3.0 native TSV has no strand column (confirmed in upstream run_phigaro.py). Strand is NOT required for lossless nucleotide interval extraction; consumers that need orientation must treat it as absent and never infer it

semantic_dimensions.name: topology_and_circularity
semantic_dimensions.value: source carries no topology/origin marker; every one of the 132404 rows satisfies begin<=end (non-wrapping, enforced by the row parser), so interval extraction is an unambiguous forward slice that does not require a topology assumption

semantic_dimensions.name: contig_edge_behavior
semantic_dimensions.value: extraction uses the declared [begin,end] verbatim; Phigaro 2.3.0 emits the span genes[phage.begin].begin..genes[phage.end].end with no clipping/extension in the TSV; edge callability/completeness is an interpretation property, not an extraction rule

semantic_dimensions.name: completeness
semantic_dimensions.value: no source completeness field; not required to extract the declared interval; edge/length diagnostics are not completeness labels

semantic_dimensions.name: duplicate_locus_rules
semantic_dimensions.value: the 132404-row snapshot has zero duplicate (genome,scaffold,begin,end) groups (enforced by the source profile); no deduplication is required and every row is preserved

coordinate_candidates.canonical_transform: extract contig[begin-1:end] (0-based half-open) i.e. Python slice contig[begin-1:end]; length=end-begin+1

coordinate_candidates.rejection_reason: 0-based is the Phigaro v2.4.0 convention (begin-1/end-1); the historical CSV matches v2.3.0 1-based exactly (56/56, delta 0), not v2.4.0 (delta -1)

extraction_gate.scope_rule: extraction is permitted for all_records, transposable_flag_positive, and taxonomy_assigned scopes alike; the three scopes remain distinct and none is silently relabeled
extraction_gate.modern_v2_4_pilot_separation: modern_v2_4_pilot=GO concerns only a new v2.4.0 callset and is NOT the basis of this historical GO; this GO rests solely on historical_csv_attribution=DECISIVE independently reverified
extraction_gate.release_rule: A consumer must require verdict == EXTRACTION_GO and must reject missing, unknown, CONDITIONAL, or EXTRACTION_BLOCKED.
